MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The card reader with extra USB ports feels useful because it connects devices and adds connection options, much like my USB expansion card and Ethernet adapter.",
    "The SSD enclosure and WiFi card fit my interest in practical adapters, though I would only choose them if I had a compatible drive or a specific network upgrade need."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The server case and memory kit assume a computer-building or upgrade project that my accessory purchases do not establish.",
    "Keyboards and speaker stands do not solve a connection need for me; owning a headset does not mean I need a speaker setup.",
    "The RCA converter connects equipment, but my DVI cable purchase gives me no reason to need an older RCA device connected now."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying computer accessories seems to have been taken as interest in computer hardware generally.",
    "A shared word such as wireless, audio, or adapter seems to matter too much when the actual purpose differs from what I need."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My history points toward occasional, specific connection problems, so a clear practical use matters more to me than a related product type.",
    "Compatibility and an immediate need determine whether I would act; an interesting adapter alone is not enough.",
    "My purchases are spread over years, so they do not establish an ongoing upgrade project or a need to replace working equipment."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognize my interest in useful connection accessories but stretch it into hardware projects and replacement needs I have not shown."
}
